name: Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric
sku: The Real-Time Intelligence workload of Microsoft Fabric (Real-Time hub, Eventstreams, Eventhouse and Activator) on a Fabric capacity. Eventhouse anomaly detection is marked preview on the deployment pipelines page and is not scored.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: Eventstreams collect and send large volumes of real-time data with no code, from connectors including Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, AWS Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub and MQTT.

ingest.cdc.note: Eventstreams and the Real-Time hub accept database change data capture feeds from Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB and PostgreSQL. It is a streaming source, not a general CDC replicator.

transform.stream-processing.note: Eventstreams filter, clean, transform, apply windowed aggregations and detect duplicates, with content-based routing and derived eventstreams that others can consume.

store.olap-serving.note: Eventhouses are the analytics engine for data in motion. Data is organised by arrival time and indexed and partitioned for fast queries over large amounts of data.

serve.query-engine.note: Eventhouse data is queried in native KQL or in T-SQL from the KQL queryset, with code, low-code and no-code options.

serve.bi-viz.note: Real-Time dashboards and KQL querysets visualise data seconds after ingestion, and the same data feeds Power BI reports.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: Activator alerts run actions when data patterns or conditions are met, including Fabric pipelines, Spark jobs and Dataflows, so orchestration can be event-driven without schedules.

presentation.tagline: Streaming ingestion, KQL analytics and event-driven actions in Fabric.
